decision: Can a uniformly randomized, four-policy-root action intention create auditable factual exposure while preserving the per-root observed-shield, action-delivery, lifecycle, propensity, and complete-episode contracts?

hypotheses.H1_boundary_repair: A run-local assignment group, step, intended action, assignment propensity, and override reason remove the ambiguity between a repeated draw and a held intention without changing actor observations or shield authority.
hypotheses.H2_exposure: At least 80% of eligible complete groups have no shield override and at least four witnessed intended-action executions.
hypotheses.H3_support: Each complete Stage 4 episode contains at least 4000 eligible four-root groups, and every canonical action receives at least 100 randomized assignments across the two pilot-train episodes.
hypotheses.H4_safety: Every published root remains inside its freshly recomputed observed-shield set; an inadmissible retained intention uses the current reactive baseline, while an unsafe in-flight input remains a fail-closed control dead-end rather than a fabricated override.
hypotheses.H5_selection_limit: Passing selects a separately frozen scaled training collection after a serial-versus-parallel differential for the stateful policy. It does not select a hazard model, value learner, learned policy, Wine canary, or gameplay claim.

sizing_evidence.scope: read-only observed-mask persistence on eight immutable L2d factual behavior continuations; no counterfactual successor

collection.stop_rule: collect both fixed slots; retain every physical HIT; reject and retry only infrastructure-invalid or Bomb-bearing attempts; stop incomplete after three infrastructure attempts for either slot

pilot_data_use: train-only after a passing collection contract; never evaluation or promotion evidence
non_goals: no learned actor, hazard model, critic, IQL, CQL, OPE, history encoder, object encoder, calibration, or learner fit
no counterfactual successor, ECL interpreter, future-birth envelope, shield widening, route logic, stage pattern rule, RNG input, or source identity
no physical-HIT retry, stop-on-hit output, Bomb, accelerated clock, parallel Wine, adaptive collection, or result peeking
no claim that a shield override estimates the unsafe intended action; assignment, conditional publication, execution, and outcome remain separate factual fields
